collection.title: Toyota Prius 2009 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Toyota Prius 2009 to 2015 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Prius which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
